value.rationale: The finding repairs a concrete reproducibility failure in an explicit trifferent-code construction with a short, fully replayable inner code. A valid dimension-6 inner code is structurally necessary for the concatenation argument; length 25 recovers a nontrivial explicit asymptotic rate 23/325, and the exact projective/weight data make the replacement independently checkable. This is more than a routine recomputation because it supplies the missing constructive object while clearly separating the repaired statement from the unresolved stronger length-24 claim.
